title: Venezuelan Milk Chocolate Empanadas
description: A lightly sweet and comforting Venezuelan dish featuring milk chocolate in a flaky crust, perfect for a snack or dessert. This ovo-vegetarian friendly treat is a twist on traditional empanadas.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and water.
Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll each ball out into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of sugar and a few chocolate chips in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with a little bit of water.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
